description: Read one managed source file with its exact hash and mode. UTF-8 content_text is the default; binary files retain content_base64 with guidance. Use format base64 for legacy byte payloads, and keep the executable flag when replacing a file.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
